text:
SRE-Bot: ALERT: canary-probe.eu-west.response-latency — 14 failures in 5m. Severity: P2. Link: https://ops.redwood/grafana/d/synthetic-canaries
Alex: oncall taking this. seeing same in the alert stream. starting triage now. @Maria can you pull the probe logs?
Maria: looking. grafana shows flapping 200 -> 503 from the canary client for three endpoints. origin service traces show successful responses. hypothesis: probe client timeouts/short-lived connection issues, not backend errors.
Jamie: can we silence the noisy alert while you dig? don't want repeated pages for false positives. if we mute, add context in the alert.
Alex: muting alert for 30m while we investigate: `/alert mute canary-probe.eu-west 30m --reason "investigating probe client timeouts"`
SRE-Bot: Confirmed: canary-probe.eu-west muted by Alex for 30m. PagerDuty incident PD-45321 linked.
Sanjay: digging into probe agent metrics — client GC/CPU spikes aligned with failure windows. Probe uses Go http client with 2s timeout and creates new client per check. GC pauses occasionally cause requests to miss the 2s window.
Maria: proposed mitigations: increase probe timeout, add connection reuse, and reduce probe frequency to avoid amplifying flaps. Suggest config changes for eu-west canary pool: 
```json
{
  "probe_timeout_ms": 8000,
  "probe_interval_s": 45,
  "failure_consecutive": 5,
  "reuse_http_client": true
}
```
Alex: roll changes behind a feature flag + canary rollout (5% -> 50% -> 100%). Also create a temporary suppression rule that groups by probe-client-version to avoid muting unrelated alerts. Add a dashboard panel: synthetic-probes/false-positive-rate (1h moving window).
Jamie: I created INC-9873 and attached the initial notes + links to the runbook: https://wiki.redwood/ops/canary-runbook. Adding steps: rollback, re-enable old config, and who to page if real customer impact.
Oncall-Rotation: handing monitoring to me for the change window. I'll watch real-customer-error-rate and latency. If customer errors > 1% or user-facing lat spikes, escalate to P1 and page infra-sre.
Maria: applying change to eu-west canary pool (5% rollout). Will watch for 20m then increase. Deploy command: `infractl deploy canary-config --env eu-west --flag probe-timeout-8s --rollout 5%`
SRE-Bot: Update: canary failures dropped to 2 in the last 10m since config change. Mute still active for 15m.
Alex: good sign. leaving notes: follow-up items — 1) add probe-client persistent connection support in the probe repo, 2) new alert variant that separates client-timeout vs origin-5xx, 3) dashboard with per-client GC spikes. Assign: Maria (#1), Sanjay (#3), Jamie (#2) — target EOD tomorrow.
Jamie: noted and created tasks in ENG-OPS board. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: also recommending we add jitter to probe schedule to avoid simultaneous bursts across thousands of canaries. I'll open a PR with sim results.
Oncall-Rotation: I'll monitor until the mute expires and then verify alert noise level before closing this thread. If everything stays green, we'll schedule a 1hr post-incident review tomorrow.
Alex: thanks team. post-mortem action: add an eval harness to simulate GC-induced false positives and include that in pre-deploy checks for probe client changes.
SRE-Bot: Auto-note: incident closed from P2 -> monitoring after 45m. Logs archived to /var/ops/incidents/1799554321.
Maria: closing our changes in canary pool for now. will follow up with PR links in INC-9873.
Oncall-Rotation: handing off back to next oncall at 1799554710. Keeping an eye during the morning shift.
Alex: thanks — good mitigation and low customer impact.
